sources.search_query: Türkiye foreign ministry tourist visa information for foreigners mfa.gov.tr
sources.relevant_excerpt: The Electronic Visa (e-Visa) Application System was launched on 17 April 2013 by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Türkiye. [...] E-visa is only valid when the purpose of travel is tourism or commerce. [...] Fees for e-Visas obtained via the e-Visa website (www.evisa.gov.tr) are lower than the fees for visas obtained upon arrival to Turkish airports. [...] China: Ordinary passport holder People's Republic of China nationals are exempt from visa up to 90 days in any 180 day period as of 2 January 2026. United States: Ordinary passport holders are exempted from visa up to 90 days in any 180-day period. United Kingdom: Ordinary passport holders who travel for touristic purposes are exempt from visas for up to 90 days in any 180 day period. India: Diplomatic passport holders are exempt from visa for their travels to Türkiye up to 90 days. Taiwan: Ordinary and official passport holders are required to have visa to enter Türkiye. Australia: Holders of ordinary passports are exempt from visa requirements for touristic visits and transit travel for a period of 90 days within any 180-day period. Canada: Ordinary passport holders are exempted from visa up to 90 days in any 180-day period. Russian Federation: Ordinary passport holders are exempted from visa for their touristic and business travels up to 60 days. United Arab Emirates: Ordinary and official passport holders are exempted from visa up to 90 days in any 180-day period. Hong Kong: Ordinary and official 'Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the People's Republic of China (SAR) Passport' holders are exempted from visa for their travels up to 90 days.
sources.effective_date_evidence: China entry states exemption applies 'as of 2 January 2026'; e-Visa system 'launched on 17 April 2013'

policies.policy_name: Türkiye visa exemptions for touristic travel (MFA country-by-country list)
policies.description: The MFA 'Visa Information For Foreigners' page lists, country by country, which passport holders are exempt from visa and for how long. Most exempt nationalities get 90 days (many explicitly '90 days in any 180-day period'); some have shorter limits (e.g. Russia 60 days; Belarus, Indonesia and Thailand 30 days per entry per the same page). China (ordinary passports) was added as of 2 January 2026. The 16 pipeline target nationalities were verified verbatim; the broader membership below reflects the fetched page but was not individually verbatim-verified for duration.
conditions: Generally ordinary passport holders; some entries cover official passports too; touristic purposes
Durations vary by nationality: typically 90 days (often within any 180-day period); Russia 60 days; Belarus/Indonesia/Thailand 30 days per entry per the MFA page
Kosovo also appears on the MFA page but has no standard ISO alpha-3 code and is omitted from the list above
policies.maximum_stay: typically 90 days in any 180-day period (30 or 60 days for some nationalities)

policies.policy_name: Republic of Türkiye Electronic Visa (e-Visa) Application System
policies.description: Official e-Visa launched 17 April 2013 by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, applied for online at www.evisa.gov.tr. Valid only for tourism or commerce. 48 nationalities/travel documents are eligible 'provided that they meet required criteria'; per-country criteria, fee and validity are displayed inside the application flow. Conditional nationalities must hold a valid Schengen/USA/UK/Ireland visa or residence permit, a return ticket, hotel reservation and at least 50 USD per day, and enter via airports (not valid at land border checkpoints).
conditions: Tourism or commerce only; other purposes require a consular visa
List also covers 'Hong Kong (BN(O))' British National (Overseas) passports (no distinct ISO code; not included in the code list above)
Croatia, Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania appear on the eligible list although the MFA lists them as visa-exempt for ordinary passports

policies.policy_name: Visa on arrival at Turkish airports (fee schedule as of 1 May 2014)
policies.description: The MFA visa information page states that fees for e-Visas obtained via www.evisa.gov.tr are lower than fees for visas obtained upon arrival to Turkish airports, and the MFA fee schedule PDF (dated 10 November 2014) lists visa-on-arrival fees at Turkish airports for 38 nationalities. The schedule predates later exemptions (e.g. USA, Canada, UAE, Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, Oman, China), so the current practical scope of visa on arrival could not be confirmed on a current-dated official page.
conditions: Fee table dated 10 November 2014, 'as of 1 May 2014'; most listed nationalities have since become visa-exempt
Hong Kong BN(O) passports also listed (no distinct ISO code)

policies.policy_name: Turkish sticker visa via Pre-Application System
policies.description: Since 5 January 2016 all Turkish sticker (consular) visa applications must be made through the Pre-Application System (www.visa.gov.tr; pre-application and appointments also via www.konsolosluk.gov.tr). Applicants upload data online (or via a visa application center), then submit signed forms and passports at the Turkish Mission or, where designated, at an authorized visa application center (e.g. Anatolia Visa Application Centers, sole authorized provider for Turkish missions in Pakistan since 1 May 2021). Where internet is weak, applications can still be made directly at Turkish Missions. Work and study visas are issued by Turkish Embassies or Consulates.
conditions: Default channel for nationalities that are neither visa-exempt nor able to use the e-Visa, and for purposes other than tourism/commerce

passport_validity.condition_text: Foreigners wishing to enter Türkiye should carry a travel document (passport) with an expiration date at least 60 days beyond the 'duration of stay' of their visa, visa exemption or residence permit (e.g. a 90-day duration of stay requires a passport valid for at least 150 days). Entry is refused where the passport or travel document expires sixty days prior to the expiry of the visa, visa exemption or residence permit. The MFA additionally advises holding a travel document valid for at least 6 months from the date of arrival in Türkiye. No blank-page rule stated on the fetched pages.

unresolved: The e-Visa portal homepage (https://www.evisa.gov.tr/ and /en/) returned a 302 cross-host redirect to https://dtvgroup.com.tr/ for non-browser clients (redirect_chain: https://www.evisa.gov.tr/en/ -> https://dtvgroup.com.tr/, which returned empty content); the static eligibility page under /en/info/ did load and is cited. Per-country e-Visa criteria, validity, max stay and current fees are displayed only inside the interactive application flow and could not be captured — notably current e-Visa fee/validity/stay for India and Taiwan.

The only fetchable official fee schedule (mfa.gov.tr vize-harc-miktarlari-en.pdf) is dated 10 November 2014 (visa-on-arrival column 'as of 1 May 2014'). Many nationalities in it (USA, GBR, CAN, AUS, ARE, SAU, BHR, OMN, KWT, CHN later) have since become visa-exempt, so these fee rows are largely legacy; current per-country fees are shown only in the e-Visa application flow.

Current operational scope of visa on arrival at Turkish airports could not be confirmed on a current-dated official page; evidence is the present-tense MFA sentence comparing e-Visa and on-arrival fees plus the 2014 fee table.

Visa-exemption list membership beyond the 16 target nationalities was taken from a fetched-but-summarized rendering of the MFA country-by-country page; the 16 targets were verbatim-verified, the rest were not individually verbatim-verified (durations for some, e.g. Belarus/Indonesia/Thailand 30 days, from the same fetch). Kosovo omitted (no standard ISO alpha-3 code).
Whether Russia's 60-day exemption is additionally capped at 90 days in any 180-day period is not stated in the fetched MFA text.

Authorized visa application centers vary by country (e.g. Anatolia Visa Application Centers in Pakistan, verified; Dubai mission reportedly directs to www.gatewayinternational.com.tr but that mission page was not fetched, so it is not recorded).
